jury.why: The User & Brand Advocate's peer review failed on a provider rate limit, so its scores stand unrevised while the other four were tested — and its untested A1=11 is the sole reason the A1 median is 9.5 rather than 9 (the three tested scores are 9, 9, 10); compounding that, B5 jumped 5 to 7 and B4 3.5 to 5 in one round with four of five advisors clustered at the ceiling on each.

summary: A genuinely well-crafted round — all five machine gates pass, the type and motion systems are structurally locked, and the copy could only be Pip — undercut by three verified defects the gate cannot see: undeclared --pt-safe-min/--pb-safe-min erasing the declared page gutters on nine screens, every chat message still rendered as a real <button> with a skip link that skips nothing, and a keepsake generator that deletes the user's own last sentence from the two cards they actually read.
